Use `AGENTS.md` as the repository map and treat `docs/` as the source of truth. This project is a deterministic, local-first security analysis tool: never introduce mandatory LLM calls, telemetry, hosted dependencies, or execution of scanned repository code. Before completing code changes, run `npm run verify`. For detector work, follow `.agents/skills/add-detector/SKILL.md`; for reviews, follow `.agents/skills/security-review/SKILL.md`.
